import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
from scipy import stats

# Read the data
df = pd.read_excel('/workspace/pone.0150501.s002.xls', sheet_name='RAW DATA', header=1)

# Rename the first column to 'miRNA'
df.rename(columns={'Unnamed: 0': 'miRNA'}, inplace=True)

print("Data shape:", df.shape)
print("Columns:", df.columns.tolist())
print()

# Separate patient (P) and control (C) columns
patient_cols = [col for col in df.columns if col.startswith('P')]
control_cols = [col for col in df.columns if col.startswith('C')]

print(f"Patient columns ({len(patient_cols)}): {patient_cols}")
print(f"Control columns ({len(control_cols)}): {control_cols}")
print()

# Extract miRNA names and expression data
miRNAs = df['miRNA'].values
patient_data = df[patient_cols].values
control_data = df[control_cols].values

print(f"Number of miRNAs: {len(miRNAs)}")
print(f"Patient data shape: {patient_data.shape}")
print(f"Control data shape: {control_data.shape}")
print()

# Perform t-tests for each miRNA
p_values = []
for i in range(len(miRNAs)):
    patient_vals = patient_data[i, :]
    control_vals = control_data[i, :]

    # Perform independent t-test
    t_stat, p_val = stats.ttest_ind(patient_vals, control_vals)
    p_values.append(p_val)

p_values = np.array(p_values)

print("P-values summary:")
print(f"  Min p-value: {p_values.min():.6f}")
print(f"  Max p-value: {p_values.max():.6f}")
print(f"  Median p-value: {np.median(p_values):.6f}")
print()

# Count significant miRNAs (using p < 0.05 as threshold)
# BEFORE multiple testing correction
significant_mask = p_values < 0.05
significant_count = np.sum(significant_mask)
total_count = len(miRNAs)
percentage = (significant_count / total_count) * 100

print(f"=== RESULTS BEFORE MULTIPLE TESTING CORRECTION ===")
print(f"Total miRNAs: {total_count}")
print(f"Significant at p < 0.05: {significant_count}")
print(f"Percentage: {percentage:.1f}%")
print()

# Show how many are significant at various thresholds
print("Number of significant miRNAs at different p-value thresholds:")
for thresh in [0.05, 0.01, 0.001]:
    count = np.sum(p_values < thresh)
    pct = (count / total_count) * 100
    print(f"  p < {thresh}: {count} miRNAs ({pct:.1f}%)")
print()

# Show top differentially expressed miRNAs (lowest p-values)
print("Top 10 miRNAs with lowest p-values:")
results_df = pd.DataFrame({
    'miRNA': miRNAs,
    'p_value': p_values
})
results_df_sorted = results_df.sort_values('p_value')
print(results_df_sorted.head(10).to_string(index=False))
print()

# Also compute fold changes for context
print("Top 10 miRNAs by fold change (patient vs control):")
patient_means = patient_data.mean(axis=1)
control_means = control_data.mean(axis=1)
# Using -delta Ct as approximation for fold change (higher values = higher expression in patients)
fold_changes = control_means - patient_means  # positive means higher in patients

fc_df = pd.DataFrame({
    'miRNA': miRNAs,
    'p_value': p_values,
    'patient_mean': patient_means,
    'control_mean': control_means,

import numpy as np

df.rename(columns={'Unnamed: 0': 'miRNA'}, inplace=True)

print("Data shape:", df.shape)

# Separate patient (P) and control (C) columns
patient_cols = [col for col in df.columns if col.startswith('P')]
control_cols = [col for col in df.columns if col.startswith('C')]

print(f"Patient columns ({len(patient_cols)}): {patient_cols}")
print(f"Control columns ({len(control_cols)}): {control_cols}")
print()

# Convert all data columns to numeric, coercing errors to NaN
for col in patient_cols + control_cols:
    df[col] = pd.to_numeric(df[col], errors='coerce')

# Extract miRNA names and expression data
miRNAs = df['miRNA'].values
patient_data = df[patient_cols].values.astype(float)
control_data = df[control_cols].values.astype(float)

print(f"Number of miRNAs: {len(miRNAs)}")
print(f"Patient data shape: {patient_data.shape}")
print(f"Control data shape: {control_data.shape}")
print()

# Check for NaN values
print("NaN values per miRNA:")
nan_counts = np.sum(np.isnan(patient_data) | np.isnan(control_data), axis=1)
print(f"  miRNAs with any NaN: {np.sum(nan_counts > 0)}")
print(f"  miRNAs with all NaN: {np.sum(nan_counts == 20)}")
print()

# Perform t-tests for each miRNA
p_values = []
for i in range(len(miRNAs)):
    patient_vals = patient_data[i, :]
    control_vals = control_data[i, :]

    # Remove NaN values
    patient_vals = patient_vals[~np.isnan(patient_vals)]
    control_vals = control_vals[~np.isnan(control_vals)]

    # Need at least 2 values in each group for t-test
    if len(patient_vals) >= 2 and len(control_vals) >= 2:
        t_stat, p_val = stats.ttest_ind(patient_vals, control_vals)
    else:
        p_val = np.nan

    p_values.append(p_val)

p_values = np.array(p_values)

# Filter out NaN p-values for analysis
valid_mask = ~np.isnan(p_values)
print(f"Valid p-values: {np.sum(valid_mask)} out of {len(miRNAs)}")
print()

print(f"  Max p-value: {valid_p.max():.6f}")

print()

# Save results
results_df.to_csv('/workspace/differential_expression_results.csv', index=False)
print()
print("Results saved to /workspace/differential_expression_results.csv")
